credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Watercolor sketch of head and chest of boy facing forward. The boy has black hair and dark complexion. He wears a jacket painted in yellows and greens and a striped shirt peeks out at the collar. His eyes are slightly downcast, the background is a wash of varying shades of tan.
